messages.text: What is EVM, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

EVM is Error Vector Magnitude, a measurement of the difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform.[2]  
In 5G NR base-station modulation-quality context, EVM can express the difference between the measured carrier signal and the reference signal.[59]  
In that context, EVM is the difference between equalized ideal symbols and measured symbols, and that difference is the error vector.[59]  
| Product / instrument / application decision | What depends on understanding EVM |
|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 NR FR1 uplink analyzer option R&S CMX-KM600 | R&S CMX-KM600 is required for any NR FR1 uplink TX tests, and its 5G NR analyzer specification includes EVM < 0.5% under the stated FR1, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM, temperature, input-level and 100 MHz bandwidth conditions.[19] |
| R&S CMX500 5G NR generator option R&S CMX-KW601 | R&S CMX-KW601 has a 5G NR generator EVM specification of < 0.5% under the stated PDSCH, full-allocation, SCS, 64QAM, PAR, temperature, port, output-level and 100 MHz bandwidth conditions.[19] |
| R&S CMX500 measurement-option selection | The CMX500 ordering information lists R&S CMX-KM600 as the 5G NR analyzer and R&S CMX-KW601 as the 5G NR generator, so choosing these options depends on whether EVM-relevant NR analysis or generation is required.[20] |
| R&S CMX500 SRS RF measurement application | CMX500 SRS RF measurements include TX power, EVM and more, and support regular SRS, SRS antenna switching and SRS carrier switching modes.[11] |
| R&S CMX500 SRS resource measurement setup | CMX500 SRS measurements are aware of SRS positions and let the user select the SRS resource to measure, so understanding EVM matters when selecting which SRS resource’s EVM is measured.[11] |
| 5G NR UE pre-conformance EVM PUCCH/PUSCH testing on CMX | The 3GPP TS 38.521-1 test case 6.4.2.1 covers Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH, Test ID sets RB allocation and modulation scheme, and the measured DUT EVM must be confirmed within the specified range.[2] |
| 5G NR UE max-power and min-power EVM verification | The EVM test case requires EVM measurement at DUT maximum power and minimum power, with CMX first setting maximum power automatically and the DUT then being set to minimum power through TPC Closed Loop settings after max-power EVM verification.[2] |
| 5G NR UE modulation-dependent pass/fail interpretation | The cited 5G NR EVM limits depend on modulation: Pi/2-BPSK 30 + TT%, QPSK 17.5 + TT%, 16QAM 12.5 + TT%, 64QAM 8 + TT%, and 256QAM 3.5 + TT%.[1] |
| 5G NR UE 256QAM tolerance and min-power planning | The cited test tolerance is 0% except 256QAM, where TT is 0.3% at maximum power and 1.1% at minimum power.[1] |
| R&S CMP180 NR production-test analyzer option R&S CMP-KM600 | CMP180’s selected measurement performance lists R&S CMP-KM600 as a 5G NR analyzer with EVM < 0.5% for FR1, 100 MHz bandwidth, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM and level > –20 dBm.[24] |
| R&S CMP180 NR FR1 multi-carrier and MIMO option planning | CMP180 ordering information lists NR FR1 measurements multi-carrier as R&S CMP-KM602 and NR FR1 measurements MIMO as R&S CMP-KM604, so EVM-related NR production measurement planning may need to distinguish base analyzer performance from multi-carrier or MIMO measurement scope.[25] |
| R&S SMM100A vector-signal-generator option planning | SMM100A signal performance examples include 5G NR EVM with R&S SMM-K144, 3GPP FDD EVM with R&S SMM-K42 and IEEE 802.11be EVM with R&S SMM-K147.[30] |
| R&S FSV3000 signal/spectrum-analyzer firmware-license selection | R&S FSV3000 firmware licenses include R&S FSV3-K147 for 5G NR combined ACLR/SEM/EVM, requiring R&S FSV3-K144, and R&S FSV3-K147C for 5G NR combined multicarrier ACLR/SEM/EVM measurements, requiring R&S FSV3-K147.[37] |
| R&S FSVA3000 signal/spectrum-analyzer firmware-license selection | R&S FSVA3000 firmware licenses include R&S FSV3-K147 for 5G NR combined ACLR/SEM/EVM, requiring R&S FSV3-K144, and R&S FSV3-K147C for 5G NR combined multicarrier ACLR/SEM/EVM measurements, requiring R&S FSV3-K147.[46] |
| 5G NR base-station transmitter test application | The 5G NR base-station transmitter test material defines modulation quality as the measured carrier signal versus reference signal difference and says it can be expressed using EVM.[59] |
| 5G NR base-station EVM limit interpretation | The base-station EVM requirements listed are QPSK 18.5%, 16QAM 13.5%, 64QAM 9% and 256QAM 4.5%.[59] |
| 5G NR base-station SCPI automation | The base-station EVM SCPI example includes `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:ISRC<ant>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:EVM[:ALL][:AVERage]?`, so automation decisions depend on knowing that this query fetches average EVM.[59] |
| R&S QuickStep 5G NR base-station transmitter workflow | R&S QuickStep includes the `Tx_6_5_23_FreqErr_ModQual` transmitter-test block, linking automated base-station frequency-error and modulation-quality testing to EVM understanding.[54] |
| FSW-style 5G NR mode selection for base-station tests | The base-station manual-operation guidance says 5G NR mode is used for EVM/Frequency Err/Power, covering base-station output power, frequency error and modulation quality.[60] |
【推論】EVM understanding affects whether the user selects a communication tester such as CMX500 or CMP180 for NR EVM measurement, a vector signal generator such as SMM100A for EVM-related signal generation performance, or a signal/spectrum analyzer such as FSV3000/FSVA3000 for combined ACLR/SEM/EVM analysis.[19][24][30][37][46]

| 5G NR UE 256QAM tolerance and min-power planning | The cited test tolerance is 0% except 256QAM, where TT is 0.3% at maximum power and 1.1% at minimum power.[1] |
| R&S CMP180 NR production-test analyzer option R&S CMP-KM600 | CMP180’s selected measurement performance lists R&S CMP-KM600 as a 5G NR analyzer with EVM < 0.5% for FR1, 100 MHz bandwidth, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM and level > –20 dBm.[24] |
| R&S CMP180 NR FR1 multi-carrier and MIMO option planning | CMP180 ordering information lists NR FR1 measurements multi-carrier as R&S CMP-KM602 and NR FR1 measurements MIMO as R&S CMP-KM604, so EVM-related NR production measurement planning may need to distinguish base analyzer performance from multi-carrier or MIMO measurement scope.[25] |
| R&S SMM100A vector-signal-generator option planning | SMM100A signal performance examples include 5G NR EVM with R&S SMM-K144, 3GPP FDD EVM with R&S SMM-K42 and IEEE 802.11be EVM with R&S SMM-K147.[30] |
| R&S FSV3000 signal/spectrum-analyzer firmware-license selection | R&S FSV3000 firmware licenses include R&S FSV3-K147 for 5G NR combined ACLR/SEM/EVM, requiring R&S FSV3-K144, and R&S FSV3-K147C for 5G NR combined multicarrier ACLR/SEM/EVM measurements, requiring R&S FSV3-K147.[37] |
| R&S FSVA3000 signal/spectrum-analyzer firmware-license selection | R&S FSVA3000 firmware licenses include R&S FSV3-K147 for 5G NR combined ACLR/SEM/EVM, requiring R&S FSV3-K144, and R&S FSV3-K147C for 5G NR combined multicarrier ACLR/SEM/EVM measurements, requiring R&S FSV3-K147.[46] |
| 5G NR base-station transmitter test application | The 5G NR base-station transmitter test material defines modulation quality as the measured carrier signal versus reference signal difference and says it can be expressed using EVM.[59] |
| 5G NR base-station EVM limit interpretation | The base-station EVM requirements listed are QPSK 18.5%, 16QAM 13.5%, 64QAM 9% and 256QAM 4.5%.[59] |
| 5G NR base-station SCPI automation | The base-station EVM SCPI example includes `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:ISRC<ant>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:EVM[:ALL][:AVERage]?`, so automation decisions depend on knowing that this query fetches average EVM.[59] |
| R&S QuickStep 5G NR base-station transmitter workflow | R&S QuickStep includes the `Tx_6_5_23_FreqErr_ModQual` transmitter-test block, linking automated base-station frequency-error and modulation-quality testing to EVM understanding.[54] |
| FSW-style 5G NR mode selection for base-station tests | The base-station manual-operation guidance says 5G NR mode is used for EVM/Frequency Err/Power, covering base-station output power, frequency error and modulation quality.[60] |
【推論】EVM understanding affects whether the user selects a communication tester such as CMX500 or CMP180 for NR EVM measurement, a vector signal generator such as SMM100A for EVM-related signal generation performance, or a signal/spectrum analyzer such as FSV3000/FSVA3000 for combined ACLR/SEM/EVM analysis.[19][24][30][37][46]

answer.question: What is EVM, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it? Explain EVM and list product-related measurement decisions (Rohde & Schwarz products/instruments/options/applications) that depend on understanding EVM, with citations to Raw evidence.

passages.text:
EVM › 1C111 中的 5G NR EVM limits
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]，EVM measurement results 必須低於 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.4.2.1.5-1 的 maximum error percentage，並套用 Table 6.4.2.1.5-2 定義的 Test Tolerance（TT）。來源摘錄的 Average EVM Level limits 為：

| Modulation | Average EVM level limit |
|---|---|
| Pi/2-BPSK | 30 + TT % |
| QPSK | 17.5 + TT % |
| 16 QAM | 12.5 + TT % |
| 64 QAM | 8 + TT % |
| 256 QAM | 3.5 + TT % |

TT 來源摘錄為：

| 條件 | TT |
|---|---|
| All except 256QAM | 0% |
| 256 QAM @ max power | 0.3% |
| 256 QAM @ min power | 1.1% |

來源範例：DUT on n78、100 MHz BW、PUCCH Test ID 1（QPSK）時，specified maximum EVM 為 **17.5 + 0 %**，且 CMX EVM measurement 位於 3GPP limits 內。

EVM › 來源定義
依 [[WIC Glossary]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- EVM 展開為 Error Vector Magnitude。

依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- Error Vector Magnitude（EVM）是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。
- 來源將 EVM 放在 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] test case **6.4.2.1 Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH**。
- Test ID 會設定 RB Allocation 與 modulation scheme。
- PUCCH subtests 需參考 application note chapter 2.1 notes。
- Apply configuration 後，需確認 measured DUT EVM 位於 specified range 內。
- Test case 要求在 DUT max power 與 min power 下量測 EVM。
- CMX 會先自動設定 max power；完成 max power EVM verification 後，DUT 需使用 TPC Closed Loop settings 設定為 min power。

[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 對同一 test case 的定義與限值摘要相同，並支撐既有 EVM 頁面內容。

EVM › 使用限制
- 本頁不是完整 EVM measurement tutorial，也不是 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 標準全文。
- [[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開；[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 只提供 selected NR-FR1 SA test case 摘要。
- 不可由此頁推論 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi、LTE、NR 或 production line test 的所有 EVM limits。
- 任何正式 pass / fail limit 應回查對應標準、儀器文件、software version 與 test condition。

EVM
[[EVM]] 是 Error Vector Magnitude；[[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開，[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 則在 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test case 6.4.2.1 中說明 EVM 是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。

EVM › 與既有測試脈絡的關係
- [[FWA CPE]] 與 [[FWA CPE 測試與驗證]] 中的戶外高階 mmWave ODU DVT 項目列出 FR2 EVM，但來源未提供 EVM limit、測試配置或標準章節。
- [[Small Cell BTS 測試資料清單]] 保存 base station Tx / Rx / OTA tests 檔名，但附件未擷取，因此不能補充 EVM 測項。
- [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 補入的是 NR-FR1 SA UE pre-conformance EVM PUCCH/PUSCH 脈絡，不等同 FR2、Wi-Fi、LTE、base station 或 production-line EVM limits。

EVM › unresolved
- EVM 的完整公式、filtering、averaging、reference waveform 產生方式與 test equipment uncertainty 未由 [[WIC Glossary]] 提供。
- [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 只摘錄 selected 3GPP conformance limits；完整 tables 需回查 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]]。
- [[FWA CPE]] 中 FR2 EVM 的標準依據與測試條件未標示。

EVM › 與 min power 的關係
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]：

- [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.3.1.3-1 定義 minimum power（Pmin）。
- Channel BW 3–20 MHz 的 minimum output power 為 -40 dBm。
- Channel BW 25–100 MHz 的 minimum output power 為 -40 + 10log10(BW/20)。
- 256QAM Test IDs 的 target power 為 **Pmin + 10 dB**。
- 來源另以 100 MHz BW 說明 min power according to Table 6.3.1.3-1 略低於 33 dB；此處照來源摘要保留單位字樣，不自行改寫。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › Option 線索
來源明示：

- [[R&S CMX-KS610B]] NR SIG EXT. FSET3 – for SRS carrier switching（來自 [[CMX500_Callbox]]）。

來源未列出 [[R&S CMX-KS610B]] 的完整 order number，也未列出是否需要 [[R&S CMX-KM600]]、[[R&S CMX-KM604]]、receiver-chain hardware options 或其他 measurement options；需回正式 CMX500 features / configuration guide。

[[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 雖提到 receiver side “on CMX”，但未標示完整 CMX 型號、software release、option stack 或 UI / automation 設定方式；不可據此推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 所有版本均支援所有 receiver pre-adder / selection 場景。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements
[[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] RF measurement use case：針對 5G NR [[SRS]] modes / configurations 執行 TX power、[[EVM]] 等量測，並支援 [[SRS antenna switching]] / carrier switching 場景；[[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 進一步補充 SRS antenna switching 的 xTyR 技術背景與 receiver-side [[Receiver Pre-adder]] / selection 概念。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › 使用限制
- 本頁同時使用 [[CMX500_Callbox]]（Market / company restricted sales-training 簡報）與 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]（Knowledge / company confidential 技術筆記）。兩者都不能取代正式 [[R&S CMX500]] specifications、feature list、release note 或 3GPP 標準原文。
- 「supports all」屬 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 來源用語，需以正式 feature list、release note、3GPP scope 與 configurator 驗證。
- [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 引用 [[3GPP TS 38.214]] 但未標示版本；所有 xTyR、guard period、slot resource 限制需以正式 3GPP TS 38.214 對應版本核對。
- Receiver pre-adder / selection 的 implementation、receiver-chain allocation、calibration、measurement accuracy 與 UI / API 設定仍缺 formal source。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › SRS modes and configurations
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- CMX supports all SRS modes：regular SRS、SRS antenna switching、SRS carrier switching。
- CMX supports all SRS configurations，例如 1T2R、1T4R、2T4R（2 SRS sent at a time on 4 antennas overall）。
- Specific SRS measurements 包含 TX Power、EVM and more。
- Scheduling is automatically adapted。
- Measurement is aware of the SRS positions。
- 使用者可 select the SRS resource to measure。

依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]，[[3GPP TS 38.214]] 中的 xTyR 表示：同一時間 UE 以 Y 個 antennas 中的 X 個 antennas 同時傳送某個 SRS resource 的 X 個 SRS APs；另一時間再以其他 X 個 antennas 傳送另一個 SRS resource 的 X 個 SRS APs。來源列出的 configurations 包含 1T2R、2T4R、1T4R、1T4R/2T4R、1T=1R、2T=2R、4T=4R。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › unresolved
- [[CMX500_Callbox]] 未列出完整 option stack、BOM、DUT 條件或測試報告。
- [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 未標示正式日期、文件版本、作者、適用 CMX software release 或 receiver pre-adder configuration command。
- 來源中的 draw.io 圖與 Figure 1–5 轉檔不完整，需回原 PDF / 圖檔確認。
- 需要正式 [[3GPP TS 38.214]] 原文來驗證 Section 6.2.1.2 的 configuration list、guard period 與 xTyR 定義。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › 文件依據與版次
本頁並列使用兩份來源：

| 來源 | 文件類型 | 文件編號 | 版次 / 軟體 | 日期 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] | Specifications | PD 5216.4127.22 | Version 11.00 | August 2025 | binding specifications、hardware unit 型號、order number、環境、尺寸、電源、service |
| [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] | Features and Functions | 1179.1164.02 | Version 32；CSW 9.20.0 and higher | 來源未標示；© 2026 | GUI、software features、signaling / application / measurement options 與使用介面 |

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合指定 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。文件區分 specifications with limits、non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 uncertainties；non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擔保。

[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 明示：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding**。它是 features/functions overview，不是 technical specifications datasheet。

R&S CMX500 › Warranty and service
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]：

- Base unit warranty：1 year。
- All other items warranty：1 year。
- Calibration service plans：up to five years；on demand 為 pay per calibration。
- Warranty and repair service plans：up to five years；on demand 為 standard price repair。
- Extended periods：contact [[Rohde & Schwarz]] sales office。

R&S CMX500 › Spectrum analysis
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM140 提供 spectrum analysis options，包含 frequency sweep measurement（power vs frequency）與 zero span measurement（power vs time）。General settings 包含 external attenuation **-50 dB 至 90 dB**、sweep count **1 至 100**、sweep points **101 至 100001**；frequency sweep RBW **100 Hz 至 10 MHz**，VBW **10 Hz 至 10 MHz**。

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 另提供 FFT spectrum analyzer span 與 FFT length，詳見 ARB 與 FFT spectrum analyzer 章節。

R&S CMX500 › RF generator
Output level uncertainties 適用於 continuous wave，不適用於 overrange；wideband applications 可能產生 additional uncertainties。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要 option。NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD 與 TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，R&S CMX-KM600 option 的 5G NR analyzer 條件為 FR1、SCS 30 kHz、16QAM、temperature range +15 °C to +35 °C；input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。Frequency measurement uncertainty：**< 20 Hz + drift of timebase**；相對於同一台 CMX500 device 的 downlink signal 進行 frequency error measurements 時，uncertainty 符合 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] V18.5.0。

R&S CMX-KW601 option 的 5G NR generator 條件：5G NR PDSCH、full allocation、SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz、modulation 64QAM、PAR 11.8 dB、temperature +15 °C to +35 °C；ports RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4；output level –5 dBm、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。

R&S CMX500 › Measurement options

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › SCPI remote control
來源說 SCPI（Standard Commands for Programmable Instruments）於 1990 年由 SCPI consortium 首次發布，作為 IEEE 488.2 specification 之上的額外層，用於建立控制 T&M devices 的 syntax 與 command common standard。

SCPI commands 是 ASCII textual strings，可透過 GPIB、RS-232、USB、Ethernet 等 physical layer 傳送到儀器。

來源列出 SCPI 規則：

- SCPI commands 不分大小寫。
- 大寫字母部分為 mandatory。
- 小寫字母可省略，省略後稱為 short form。
- 方括號內的部分非 mandatory，可省略。
- 尖括號代表 parameters。
- 多個 SCPI commands 可用 semicolon 合併為 single-line string。
- 第二個 command 開頭使用 colon 可將 command tree path reset 到 root，例如 `TRIG1:SOUR CH1;:CHAN2:STATe ON`。
- Rohde & Schwarz remote control drivers 參考網址：`https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/drivers-remote-control`。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.6 Unwanted emissions
來源依 ITU definitions 說 unwanted emissions 包含：

- out-of-band emissions。
- spurious emissions。

Out-of-band emissions 是位於 channel bandwidth 立即外側，由 modulation process 與 transmitter non-linearity 造成的 unwanted emissions，不包含 spurious emissions。

Spurious emissions 是由 unwanted transmitter effects 造成的 emissions，例如 harmonics emission、parasitic emission、intermodulation products、frequency conversion products；spurious emissions 不包含 out-of-band emissions。

BS transmitter 的 out-of-band emissions requirement 以 ACLR 與 OBUE 指定。

- transmitter（Tx）
- receiver（Rx）
- performance（Px）

[[3GPP TS 38.141]] 依測試方法分為兩部分：

- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Part 1：Conducted conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] Part 2：Radiated conformance testing。

來源引用的 literature：

- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base station conformance testing, Part 1: Conducted conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base Station conformance testing Part 2: Radiated conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.104]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base Station radio transmission and reception。

- Rohde & Schwarz, Remote Control and Instrument Drivers。
- Rohde & Schwarz, Introducing SCPI Commands。

來源列出 5G NR 三大主要服務類型：

- Enhanced mobile broadband（eMBB）：提高終端使用者資料速率。
- Massive machine type communications（mMTC）：目標為具成本效率且穩健的 D2X connections。
- Ultra-reliable, low latency communications（URLLC）：支援自動駕駛、遠端手術、cloud robotics 等 vertical industries 的需求。

來源另指出 5G New Radio 技術背景可參考 Rohde & Schwarz book [3] 與 `www.rohde-schwarz.com/5G`。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.5.3 Modulation quality
- 定義為 measured carrier signal 與 reference signal 的差異。
- 可用 EVM 表示。
- EVM 是 equalization 後 ideal symbols 與 measured symbols 的差異讀值，該差異稱為 error vector。

EVM requirements：

- QPSK：18.5%。
- 16QAM：13.5%。
- 64QAM：9%。
- 256QAM：4.5%。

Frequency error 與 EVM SCPI 摘錄：

- `CONFigure[:NR5G]:DL[:CC<cc>]:IDC <State>`
- `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:ISRC<ant>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:FERRor[:AVERage]?`
- `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:ISRC<ant>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:EVM[:ALL][:AVERage]?`

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › Manual operation 共通流程
來源說多數測試共用相同初始步驟：

- 執行任何測試前，建議按下儀器前面板 PRESET 鍵，將儀器 reset 至 default state。
- 某些量測需透過 external reference 將 FSW 同步至 high precision time reference。
- 使用 external reference 時，需將 external reference signal 接至後面板 reference input，並將 reference frequency input 改為 External Reference。
- FSW 前面板可透過 SETUP key → sidebar 選 Reference → popup list 選 External Reference：10 MHz、1…50 MHz、100 MHz、1 GHz。

單次量測控制位於 front panel Function Keys：

- RUN SINGLE：開始新的 single-shot measurement，量測後停止 acquisition。
- RUN CONT：開始 continuous / repetitive measurements。

- Spectrum mode。
- 5G NR mode。

Spectrum mode 量測用途：

- Occupied bandwidth（OBW）：對應 6.6.2。
- Transmitter spurious emissions：對應 6.6.5。

5G NR mode 量測用途：

- Transmit ON/OFF Power：用於 Transmit on/off power（6.4）。
- Channel Power ACLR：用於 ACLR（6.6.3）。
- SEM：用於 OBUE（6.6.4）。

FSW 5G NR signal analysis overview-screen 可設定：Deployment、Channel bandwidth、Test model、Center-frequency、Reference level、FSW attenuation。

R&S SMBV100B › Sweep、list mode 與 phase coherence
- Frequency and level sweep：digital sweep in discrete steps；parameters 為 RF frequency、RF level；sweep range 為 fully specified frequency and level range。
- Sweep trigger modes：auto、single、extern single、step、extern step、extern start/stop。
- Sweep source：external trigger signal（rear panel INST TRIG）、rotary knob、touch panel、remote control。
- Sweep shape：sawtooth、triangle。

- Phase coherence：R&S®SMBVB-K90 option enables phase-coherent RF outputs of two or more instruments in I/Q mode。
- Phase coherence frequency range：R&S®SMBVB-B103：80 MHz < f ≤ 3 GHz；R&S®SMBVBKB106：80 MHz < f ≤ 6 GHz。

EVM is Error Vector Magnitude, a measurement of the difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform.[2]  
In 5G NR base-station modulation-quality context, EVM can express the difference between the measured carrier signal and the reference signal.[59]  
In that context, EVM is the difference between equalized ideal symbols and measured symbols, and that difference is the error vector.[59]  
| Product / instrument / application decision | What depends on understanding EVM |
|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 NR FR1 uplink analyzer option R&S CMX-KM600 | R&S CMX-KM600 is required for any NR FR1 uplink TX tests, and its 5G NR analyzer specification includes EVM < 0.5% under the stated FR1, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM, temperature, input-level and 100 MHz bandwidth conditions.[19] |
| R&S CMX500 5G NR generator option R&S CMX-KW601 | R&S CMX-KW601 has a 5G NR generator EVM specification of < 0.5% under the stated PDSCH, full-allocation, SCS, 64QAM, PAR, temperature, port, output-level and 100 MHz bandwidth conditions.[19] |
| R&S CMX500 measurement-option selection | The CMX500 ordering information lists R&S CMX-KM600 as the 5G NR analyzer and R&S CMX-KW601 as the 5G NR generator, so choosing these options depends on whether EVM-relevant NR analysis or generation is required.[20] |
| R&S CMX500 SRS RF measurement application | CMX500 SRS RF measurements include TX power, EVM and more, and support regular SRS, SRS antenna switching and SRS carrier switching modes.[11] |
| R&S CMX500 SRS resource measurement setup | CMX500 SRS measurements are aware of SRS positions and let the user select the SRS resource to measure, so understanding EVM matters when selecting which SRS resource’s EVM is measured.[11] |
| 5G NR UE pre-conformance EVM PUCCH/PUSCH testing on CMX | The 3GPP TS 38.521-1 test case 6.4.2.1 covers Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH, Test ID sets RB allocation and modulation scheme, and the measured DUT EVM must be confirmed within the specified range.[2] |
| 5G NR UE max-power and min-power EVM verification | The EVM test case requires EVM measurement at DUT maximum power and minimum power, with CMX first setting maximum power automatically and the DUT then being set to minimum power through TPC Closed Loop settings after max-power EVM verification.[2] |
| 5G NR UE modulation-dependent pass/fail interpretation | The cited 5G NR EVM limits depend on modulation: Pi/2-BPSK 30 + TT%, QPSK 17.5 + TT%, 16QAM 12.5 + TT%, 64QAM 8 + TT%, and 256QAM 3.5 + TT%.[1] |
| 5G NR UE 256QAM tolerance and min-power planning | The cited test tolerance is 0% except 256QAM, where TT is 0.3% at maximum power and 1.1% at minimum power.[1] |
| R&S CMP180 NR production-test analyzer option R&S CMP-KM600 | CMP180’s selected measurement performance lists R&S CMP-KM600 as a 5G NR analyzer with EVM < 0.5% for FR1, 100 MHz bandwidth, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM and level > –20 dBm.[24] |
| R&S CMP180 NR FR1 multi-carrier and MIMO option planning | CMP180 ordering information lists NR FR1 measurements multi-carrier as R&S CMP-KM602 and NR FR1 measurements MIMO as R&S CMP-KM604, so EVM-related NR production measurement planning may need to distinguish base analyzer performance from multi-carrier or MIMO measurement scope.[25] |
| R&S SMM100A vector-signal-generator option planning | SMM100A signal performance examples include 5G NR EVM with R&S SMM-K144, 3GPP FDD EVM with R&S SMM-K42 and IEEE 802.11be EVM with R&S SMM-K147.[30] |
| R&S FSV3000 signal/spectrum-analyzer firmware-license selection | R&S FSV3000 firmware licenses include R&S FSV3-K147 for 5G NR combined ACLR/SEM/EVM, requiring R&S FSV3-K144, and R&S FSV3-K147C for 5G NR combined multicarrier ACLR/SEM/EVM measurements, requiring R&S FSV3-K147.[37] |
| R&S FSVA3000 signal/spectrum-analyzer firmware-license selection | R&S FSVA3000 firmware licenses include R&S FSV3-K147 for 5G NR combined ACLR/SEM/EVM, requiring R&S FSV3-K144, and R&S FSV3-K147C for 5G NR combined multicarrier ACLR/SEM/EVM measurements, requiring R&S FSV3-K147.[46] |
| 5G NR base-station transmitter test application | The 5G NR base-station transmitter test material defines modulation quality as the measured carrier signal versus reference signal difference and says it can be expressed using EVM.[59] |
| 5G NR base-station EVM limit interpretation | The base-station EVM requirements listed are QPSK 18.5%, 16QAM 13.5%, 64QAM 9% and 256QAM 4.5%.[59] |
| 5G NR base-station SCPI automation | The base-station EVM SCPI example includes `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:ISRC<ant>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:EVM[:ALL][:AVERage]?`, so automation decisions depend on knowing that this query fetches average EVM.[59] |
| R&S QuickStep 5G NR base-station transmitter workflow | R&S QuickStep includes the `Tx_6_5_23_FreqErr_ModQual` transmitter-test block, linking automated base-station frequency-error and modulation-quality testing to EVM understanding.[54] |
| FSW-style 5G NR mode selection for base-station tests | The base-station manual-operation guidance says 5G NR mode is used for EVM/Frequency Err/Power, covering base-station output power, frequency error and modulation quality.[60] |
【推論】EVM understanding affects whether the user selects a communication tester such as CMX500 or CMP180 for NR EVM measurement, a vector signal generator such as SMM100A for EVM-related signal generation performance, or a signal/spectrum analyzer such as FSV3000/FSVA3000 for combined ACLR/SEM/EVM analysis.[19][24][30][37][46]

EVM › 1C111 中的 5G NR EVM limits
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]，EVM measurement results 必須低於 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.4.2.1.5-1 的 maximum error percentage，並套用 Table 6.4.2.1.5-2 定義的 Test Tolerance（TT）。來源摘錄的 Average EVM Level limits 為：

| Modulation | Average EVM level limit |
|---|---|
| Pi/2-BPSK | 30 + TT % |
| QPSK | 17.5 + TT % |
| 16 QAM | 12.5 + TT % |
| 64 QAM | 8 + TT % |
| 256 QAM | 3.5 + TT % |

TT 來源摘錄為：

| 條件 | TT |
|---|---|
| All except 256QAM | 0% |
| 256 QAM @ max power | 0.3% |
| 256 QAM @ min power | 1.1% |

來源範例：DUT on n78、100 MHz BW、PUCCH Test ID 1（QPSK）時，specified maximum EVM 為 **17.5 + 0 %**，且 CMX EVM measurement 位於 3GPP limits 內。

EVM › 來源定義
依 [[WIC Glossary]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- EVM 展開為 Error Vector Magnitude。

依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- Error Vector Magnitude（EVM）是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。
- 來源將 EVM 放在 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] test case **6.4.2.1 Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH**。
- Test ID 會設定 RB Allocation 與 modulation scheme。
- PUCCH subtests 需參考 application note chapter 2.1 notes。
- Apply configuration 後，需確認 measured DUT EVM 位於 specified range 內。
- Test case 要求在 DUT max power 與 min power 下量測 EVM。
- CMX 會先自動設定 max power；完成 max power EVM verification 後，DUT 需使用 TPC Closed Loop settings 設定為 min power。

[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 對同一 test case 的定義與限值摘要相同，並支撐既有 EVM 頁面內容。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › SRS modes and configurations
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- CMX supports all SRS modes：regular SRS、SRS antenna switching、SRS carrier switching。
- CMX supports all SRS configurations，例如 1T2R、1T4R、2T4R（2 SRS sent at a time on 4 antennas overall）。
- Specific SRS measurements 包含 TX Power、EVM and more。
- Scheduling is automatically adapted。
- Measurement is aware of the SRS positions。
- 使用者可 select the SRS resource to measure。

依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]，[[3GPP TS 38.214]] 中的 xTyR 表示：同一時間 UE 以 Y 個 antennas 中的 X 個 antennas 同時傳送某個 SRS resource 的 X 個 SRS APs；另一時間再以其他 X 個 antennas 傳送另一個 SRS resource 的 X 個 SRS APs。來源列出的 configurations 包含 1T2R、2T4R、1T4R、1T4R/2T4R、1T=1R、2T=2R、4T=4R。

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要 option。NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD 與 TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，R&S CMX-KM600 option 的 5G NR analyzer 條件為 FR1、SCS 30 kHz、16QAM、temperature range +15 °C to +35 °C；input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。Frequency measurement uncertainty：**< 20 Hz + drift of timebase**；相對於同一台 CMX500 device 的 downlink signal 進行 frequency error measurements 時，uncertainty 符合 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] V18.5.0。

R&S CMX-KW601 option 的 5G NR generator 條件：5G NR PDSCH、full allocation、SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz、modulation 64QAM、PAR 11.8 dB、temperature +15 °C to +35 °C；ports RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4；output level –5 dBm、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › R&S QuickStep
來源說 [[R&S QuickStep]] 可將 Rohde & Schwarz testmodules 組合成 test plans，以 remote control test instruments。

- R&S QuickStep 需要 R&S License。
- 5G NR base station tests 的 testmodules 免費。
- QuickStep package 下載表示同意 royalty free software 的 Terms and conditions。
- QuickStep 支援 Windows 10、Windows 8.1、Microsoft Windows 7（64 bit, SP 1, universal C runtime）。
- QuickStep remote control interface：R&S Visa、LAN connection。
- 5G NR base station transmitter tests 位於 Block Library 的 `NR_BS_TransmitterTests`。

QuickStep Tx blocks：

- `Init`：Initialization。
- `Basics`：Basic parameters。
- `Tx_6_2_OutputPower`。
- `Tx_6_3_3_PowerDynamicRange`。
- `Tx_6_4_TransmitOnOff`。
- `Tx_6_5_23_FreqErr_ModQual`。
- `Tx_6_5_4_TimeAlign`。
- `Tx_6_6_2_OccupiedBW`。
- `Tx_6_6_3_ACLR`。
- `Tx_6_6_4_UnwantedEmissions`。
- `Tx_6_6_5_SpuriousEmissions`。
- `Tx_6_7_Tx_intermod`。
- `Tx_DemoSMW`：optional；可模擬 base station，但 vector signal generator 不能模擬所有 base station functions。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.5.3 Modulation quality
- 定義為 measured carrier signal 與 reference signal 的差異。
- 可用 EVM 表示。
- EVM 是 equalization 後 ideal symbols 與 measured symbols 的差異讀值，該差異稱為 error vector。

EVM requirements：

- QPSK：18.5%。
- 16QAM：13.5%。
- 64QAM：9%。
- 256QAM：4.5%。

Frequency error 與 EVM SCPI 摘錄：

- `CONFigure[:NR5G]:DL[:CC<cc>]:IDC <State>`
- `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:ISRC<ant>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:FERRor[:AVERage]?`
- `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:ISRC<ant>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:EVM[:ALL][:AVERage]?`

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › Manual operation 共通流程
來源說多數測試共用相同初始步驟：

- 執行任何測試前，建議按下儀器前面板 PRESET 鍵，將儀器 reset 至 default state。
- 某些量測需透過 external reference 將 FSW 同步至 high precision time reference。
- 使用 external reference 時，需將 external reference signal 接至後面板 reference input，並將 reference frequency input 改為 External Reference。
- FSW 前面板可透過 SETUP key → sidebar 選 Reference → popup list 選 External Reference：10 MHz、1…50 MHz、100 MHz、1 GHz。

單次量測控制位於 front panel Function Keys：

- RUN SINGLE：開始新的 single-shot measurement，量測後停止 acquisition。
- RUN CONT：開始 continuous / repetitive measurements。

不同 BS transmitter tests 需要不同 operation mode：

- Spectrum mode。
- 5G NR mode。

Spectrum mode 量測用途：

- Occupied bandwidth（OBW）：對應 6.6.2。
- Transmitter spurious emissions：對應 6.6.5。

5G NR mode 量測用途：

- EVM/Frequency Err/Power：用於 Base station output power（6.2）、Frequency error（6.5.2）、Modulation quality（6.5.3）。
- Time Alignment Error：用於 TAE（6.5.4）。
- Transmit ON/OFF Power：用於 Transmit on/off power（6.4）。
- Channel Power ACLR：用於 ACLR（6.6.3）。
- SEM：用於 OBUE（6.6.4）。

FSW 5G NR signal analysis overview-screen 可設定：Deployment、Channel bandwidth、Test model、Center-frequency、Reference level、FSW attenuation。
